qs.s: La ___ de 100 mètres est l'épreuve la plus spectaculaire des Jeux olympiques.
qs.en: The 100-metre race is the most spectacular event at the Olympic Games.

qs.s: Il a remporté la ___ cycliste après des mois d'entraînement intensif.
qs.en: He won the cycling race after months of intensive training.

qs.en: I need to do the shopping before tonight: there is nothing left in the fridge.

qs.en: She comes back from the supermarket, her arms loaded with shopping.

qs.en: He resumed his run after a brief pause to catch his breath.

qs.en: I am having trouble understanding this mathematics exercise.

qs.en: The doctor advised him to do exercise every day to stay in shape.

qs.en: This minister was criticized for his abusive exercise of authority.

qs.en: Food and shelter are basic needs for every human being.

qs.en: These fundamental reforms transformed the country's education system.
